boundary.description: From the junction of University Road and Wallness Lane, by a straight line E to River Irwell. Then along the River Irwell to the railway bridge near MOSI and W by the Deansgate – Eccles railway to the roundabout joining M602 and Albion Way (A5063). N by Albion Way and Salford Crescent – Swinton railway and by a beeline NE to the University Road and its junction with Wallness Lane.
